user.title: Home Online Bridge
user.description: Name of the ESPHome node that is wired to the Home Online controller (the node name, e.g. home_online_bridge). Slave mappings are added afterwards via Configure.

confirm_offline.title: Node not connected
confirm_offline.description: No ESPHome node named {device} is connected right now (its send action was not found). Add the integration anyway? Entities will work once the node is online. If the name is wrong, go back and correct it.

menu_options.discovered: Add from IDs seen on serial
menu_options.save: Save and apply (ignored IDs are saved too)
menu_options.import_bin: Import slaves from a Domati .bin file

add.title: Add mapping
add.description: Min/max are for dimmers only: HA 1-100 % is spread over this range, so 1 % still gives light. Raise the minimum until the lamp just lights.

edit_form.title: Edit mapping
edit_form.description: Min/max are for dimmers only: HA 1-100 % is spread over this range, so 1 % still gives light. Raise the minimum until the lamp just lights.

import_bin.title: Import from .bin
import_bin.description: Select the Domati .bin export of the controller. The file is only read to list its slaves and is not stored. Slaves that are already mapped are never offered again.

data.show_inputs: Also list inputs and buttons (hidden by default)

import_warn.title: Check the numbering

import_select.title: Choose slaves to add
import_select.description:
{count} slaves can be added, shown as ID · name (module), with input/output when the file says so. The type is suggested in the next step. Nothing is selected by default.

Already mapped, so not selectable ({already_count}): {already}

import_types.title: Choose the type per slave
import_types.description: {count} slaves selected. The type is pre-filled with the suggestion; dimmers get the default range, calibrate them afterwards. The slaves are added to the list and applied with Save.

error.invalid_id: ID must be a number from 0 to 999.
error.invalid_range: Min must be lower than max (min 1-99, max 2-100).
error.bin_unreadable: Could not read the uploaded file.
error.bin_too_large: The file is too large for a controller .bin (max 5 MB).
error.bin_no_modules: No module list found: this does not look like a Domati .bin.
error.bin_no_records: No slave records found: this does not look like a Domati .bin.
error.nothing_new: Every slave in this file is already mapped or ignored.
